mapper.sql: id, transfer_no, from_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_id, material_code, material_name, qty, unit, batch_no, status, operator, transfer_time, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wh_transfer (transfer_no, from_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_id, material_code, material_name, qty, unit, batch_no, status, operator, transfer_time) VALUES (#{transferNo}, #{fromWarehouseId}, #{toWarehouseId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{qty}, #{unit}, #{batchNo}, #{status}, #{operator}, #{transferTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE wh_transfer SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE wh_transfer SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wh_transfer WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
